record.paper: Sparse graphs with no polynomial-sized anticomplete pairs

dossier_meta.paper: Sparse graphs with no polynomial-sized anticomplete pairs
dossier_meta.statement_text: For every graph $H$ there exists $\varepsilon > 0$ such that in every $H$-free $\varepsilon$-bounded graph $G$ with $|G| > 1$ vertices, there is an anticomplete $(\varepsilon|G|, \varepsilon|G|)$-pair.
dossier_meta.context_text: A graph $G$ is $\varepsilon$-bounded if its maximum degree is less than $\varepsilon|G|$. By a theorem of Rödl, $H$ satisfies Conjecture 1.3 if and only if both $H$ and $\bar{H}$ satisfy Conjecture 1.4, so the two conjectures are equivalent over all $H$. For certain graphs $H$, however, 1.4 is more tractable than 1.3.
